findings.current: She rose from where she had been reclining.
findings.defect: “Rose” can imply that she stood up, while the source specifically describes her raising herself from a reclining position.
findings.rationale: 비스듬히 누워 있던 그녀가 몸을 일으켰다 describes sitting or levering herself upright from a reclined posture, not necessarily standing.
findings.replacement: She sat up from where she had been reclining.

summary: Faithful overall, with one minor physical-action ambiguity.
